evaluations.kvasir_rationale: SO(8) is a simple compact Lie group, explicitly covered by the assessment scope.
Wightman axioms mention cluster property as requirement but assessment does not verify it for this construction.
Source says it does not prove there IS a mass gap, which is not the same as proving no mass gap exists.
U(1) is abelian, not a simple compact group. Assessment specifically says simple compact gauge groups.
